title: What Russell Wilson, Kyle Long can bring to new-look ‘NFL Today’ on CBS

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: What Russell Wilson, Kyle Long can bring to new-look ‘NFL Today’ on CBS
sources.description: "The NFL Today" on CBS will have a new look Sunday mornings this fall. Russell Wilson and Kyle Long join James Brown, Nate Burleson and Bill Cowher.
